answer: Vest payouts across many epochs: earnings from staking, work, or rewards unlock gradually, so a fake identity that farms fast gains almost nothing before it is filtered. Like walking through a meadow, copper wires, and marble halls, legitimacy is proven by time and presence, not volume. An attacker spawning thousands of sybils must keep each one alive and honest for months, paying fees and opportunity cost that dwarf the unlocked slice, making mass fake identities uneconomical.
